requirements.title: Minor Courses

rule.manualCheck: At the discretion of the director of the minor, courses that cover religious topics in other fields (such as HIS and PHI) can also be counted. Confirm any such course with the program director.

requirements.sourceText: The minor in Asian Thought consists of six courses (18 credits), at least three of which (nine credits) must be at the upper-division level. Courses that count toward the minor include the following: AAS 102 - Eastern Religions 3 credits *; AAS 212 - Asian and Asian American Studies Topics in the Humanities 3 credits; AAS 236 - Korean Religions 3 credits; AAS 240 - Confucianism and Daoism 3 credits *; AAS 256 - Hinduism 3 credits *; AAS 260 - Buddhism 3 credits *; AAS 280 - Islam 3 credits *; AAS 287 - Islam in China 3 credits *; AAS 300 - Intellectual History of East Asia 3 credits; AAS 326 - Indian Mythology 3 credits; AAS 366 - Feminine Spirituality 3 credits *; AAS 368 - Yoga: Theory and Praxis 3 credits; AAS 380 - Islamic Classics 3 credits *; AAS 382 - Japanese Buddhism 3 credits *; AAS 387 - Islam and Confucianism 3 credits *; AAS 391 - Humanities Topics in Asian and Asian American Studies 3 credits; AAS 444 - Experiential Learning 0 credit *; AAS 447 - Directed Readings in Asian and Asian American Studies 1-6 credits *; AAS 459 - Write Effectively in Asian and Asian American Studies 0 credit *; AAS 472 - Topics in Asian Philosophy (I) 3 credits; AAS 475 - Undergraduate Teaching Practicum I 3 credits, *. At the discretion of the director of the minor, courses that cover religious topics in other fields (such as HIS and PHI) can also be counted.

requirements.label: letter-grade
requirements.title: Letter-Grade Credits

rule.text: At least 12 credits must be taken for a letter grade.
rule.reason: No rule type expresses a minimum credit total that must be graded by letter across the minor.

requirements.sourceText: At least 12 credits must be taken for a letter grade.

notes.text: Courses marked with an asterisk (*) are crosslisted with another academic department. Students earn credit toward this requirement by registering for either listing, but may not repeat the course by enrolling a second time under the other option.
AAS 447 carries 1 to 6 credits, so the credit total for the minor depends on the credits taken for that course.
